The title does not identify calls versus puts, buying versus writing, exercise style, strike, expiration, break-even, assignment, leverage or loss profile. Those distinctions are essential to judging financial accuracy, but no stored captions are available. The parenthetical 'No AI' is an acquisition-description creator claim and was not independently verified.

thumbnail_review.analysis: The actual image is a white-background hand-drawn composition: a brown ape occupies the left, extends one palm, and faces black handwritten text 'OPTIONS TRADING' on the right with four small yellow x marks. The two-line phrase and character silhouette remain clear at 320x180. The image communicates the topic and handmade channel identity but contains no bananas, payoff diagram, strike/expiration notation or risk cue. It therefore reinforces 'explained simply' more than the financial mechanism promised by the title. Historical upload art, CTR and A/B tests are unavailable.

script_review.financial_correctness_boundary: SEC/Investor.gov, FINRA and OCC establish the required distinctions for any later transcript audit: an option buyer receives a right and pays a premium; a writer accepts an obligation and assignment risk; strike, expiration and break-even matter; long options can expire worthless; covered calls and cash-secured puts differ materially from uncovered short options; uncovered calls can have unlimited loss; profit is not guaranteed. With no caption text, none of these points can be attributed to or checked against the video.
